headword: {国立大学|こくりつだいがく}

definitions.explanation: A university founded by the national government, such as the University of Tokyo or Kyoto University. Fees are lower than at private universities and entry is usually competitive.

examples.japanese: {国立大学|こくりつだいがく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: To get into a national university.

examples.japanese: {国立大学|こくりつだいがく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学費|がくひ}→学費：04706_gakuhi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: National universities have low tuition fees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家計|かけい}→家計：12287_kakei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦|くる}しい→苦しい：02636_kurushii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{国立大学|こくりつだいがく}しか⟦{受|う}けられない→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: Money is tight at home, so I can only apply to national universities.

notes:
Since 2004 they have been run as {国立大学法人|こくりつだいがくほうじん} (national university corporations).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国立大学|こくりつだいがく}⟦{志望|しぼう}→志望：03200_shibou⟧: aiming for a national university
- {旧帝大|きゅうていだい}: the seven former imperial universities, the most prestigious national universities
- {国公立大学|こっこうりつだいがく}: national and local public universities together

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {私立大学|しりつだいがく}: private university, the large majority of Japanese universities
- {公立大学|こうりつだいがく}: a university run by a prefecture or city
